sections.heading: The stand, run like a system
sections.text:
The stand,
run like a system
A controlled walkthrough of IAQ capability for exhibitions and partner briefings. Built for the Germany stand, reusable at every show, and able to run without the hall network.

sections.heading: How the portal runs on the floor
sections.text:
How the portal runs on the floor
Six behaviours, each doing one job on the stand.
ACCESS BY LOGIN
ACCESS
Team login
The stand team signs in. The booth screen runs the portal built for the floor rather than the public site.
SEQUENCING
Playlists by day and by audience
A different run for day one than for day three, and a different run for an engineer than for a partner or a journalist.
UNATTENDED
Loop mode
Runs itself between conversations, so the screen keeps showing the work with or without a presenter.
ATTENDED
Live present mode
The presenter drives it, jumping straight to the stop the conversation has arrived at.
RESILIENCE
Offline fallback
The whole system runs from the stand machine with no network, so the stand never depends on hall wifi.
REUSE
Built once, used at every show
Assembled for the Germany stand and reusable at every exhibition after it, with the playlist swapped rather than the system rebuilt.

sections.heading: Five stops, in the order a conversation takes
sections.text:
Five stops, in the order a conversation takes
The route is set. Each stop runs on IAQ’s project list and corporate film, and names exactly what it needs.
CONTENT TO BE SUPPLIED
01
ATTRACT
The opening loop
The piece that stops someone in the aisle before a word is said. Runs silent, reads at four metres.
THE 30 SECOND STAND LOOP CUT FROM THE CORPORATE FILM · SUPPLIED BY IAQ, BUILT AS SOON AS THE FILM ARRIVES
02
FRAME
What IAQ actually does
The delivery cycle told in one pass, so a visitor understands the span from design to maintenance before any project is shown.
WHICH DISCIPLINES LEAD PER AUDIENCE, AND THE ORDER THEY RUN IN · AGREED WITH IAQ BEFORE THE SHOW
03
QUALIFY
The market that applies to you
The visitor self identifies, and the stand run narrows to the sector they build in.
WHICH OF THE SEVEN MARKETS LEAD ON THE STAND, AND IN WHAT PRIORITY · CONFIRMED BY IAQ
04
PROVE
The work behind the claim
Projects shown at the scale that settles the question, with the numbers that matter to that sector.
THE PROJECT SELECTION, IMAGES AND WRITTEN PUBLISH PERMISSIONS, FROM THE OUTSTANDING PROJECT LIST · SUPPLIED BY IAQ
05
CONVERT
The ask, and the follow up
One clear next step per audience, captured on the stand and carried straight into follow up.
THE ASK PER AUDIENCE, THE CAPTURE METHOD AND WHO FOLLOWS UP · AGREED WITH IAQ
STOPS TWO, THREE AND FOUR RUN ON THE SAME MATERIAL AS THE SERVICES PAGES AND THE PROJECT REGISTRY, SO THE STAND AND THE SITE TELL A SINGLE, CONSISTENT STORY.

sections.heading: What the visitor leaves with
sections.text:
What the visitor leaves with
Every asset held in one place and versioned, so the stand team hands over the current file, every time, to every visitor.
ASSETS OUTSTANDING
Company profile
The print ready profile, handed over as a file at the stand and mailed afterwards from the same link.
COMPANY PROFILE PDF, CURRENT RELEASE · SUPPLIED BY IAQ
Capability one pagers
One sheet per discipline and per business model, sized to explain itself the moment it is handed over.
APPROVED CAPABILITY COPY PER DISCIPLINE AND BUSINESS MODEL · SUPPLIED BY IAQ, PRODUCED BY BRAND METHOD
Project sheets
A sheet per reference project, cleared for publication and ready to hand over.
PROJECT SHEETS WITH IMAGES AND WRITTEN PUBLISH PERMISSIONS · SUPPLIED BY IAQ
Film and stand assets
The master film, the stand loop and the still library, in the formats the booth hardware needs.
CORPORATE FILM MASTER, THE 30 SECOND LOOP AND THE STILL LIBRARY · SUPPLIED BY IAQ
Versioned: one current file per asset, with older releases retired as soon as they are superseded.
Offline first: every download sits on the stand machine before the doors open.
Tracked: what was handed over and to whom, so the follow up is specific.
